name: Intel Corporation
collect_note: Page watch only (blocker: no_listing_anywhere): Intel funds Arizona water restoration through nonprofit partners it selects itself and publishes no call, RFP or application listing, so the Arizona project page is watched and a new funded project or any added application wording is flagged for review.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET 2026-11-12 of the Arizona water restoration page: HTTP 200, 19 KB text, lists 20 funded projects with implementation partners and no application route. Intel water page (/corporate-responsibility/water.html) and the community-giving and newsroom pages returned no grant, RFP, proposal or apply wording (fetch_text grep: 0 windows). A web search found no process for proposing a project to Intel. No feed, API or call listing found on the channels tried.
